context: This week's 12 teams put up 1551.02 points between them, 129.25 a team.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: Somewhere, Joe Burrow is still on packerlove24's bench wondering why -- 34.88 points' worth of wondering, out of 84.58 total left stranded.

awards.name: You Didn't Lose!
awards.text: Jake From State Farm scored just 102.92 -- the 10th-highest score in the league this week -- but Supernova Takeover somehow scored even less (95.52), so the win counts all the same.

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: Tanner Time held Bandits to just 84.96 points -- the 12th-worst score in the league this week -- on the way to the win.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: Not close: Tanner Time beat Bandits by 37.08 points, 122.04 to 84.96.
